description: Your site profiles (privacy, terms, cookies, licence, custom_field) as JSON. list: true for names, or siteprofilename for one; field filters. Use next.arguments when a purchase reply says incomplete: true.

cursor.description: Resume token from a previous incomplete result, e.g. "doc:terms".

field.description: "all" (default), or an array from: privacy, terms, cookies, license, custom_field.

list.description: If true, return this account's profile names instead of a profile's content.

siteprofilename.description: The profile to fetch. Required unless list: true.

name: get_siteprofile
title: Get site profile
